Name: Item Bags for Wildflour's Atelier Goods
Author: passersby10086
Description:
[b][i][size=6][u]现在添加了对Rose and the Alchemist的支持

Support for Rose and the Alchemist has now been added[/u]
[/size][/i][/b]


[size=4]在item bag最新beta版的基础上对原本的袋子进行了彻底的重写。[/size]

[size=4]现在总共有10个袋子，2个是在任何情况下都可以使用的。分别是工匠机器包和野外物品包。剩下八个仅在开启了进阶模式的情况下才能生效，因此我将它们列入了可选文件。请一定不要在简单模式下使用它们。关于如何开启进阶模式，请看[/size][url=https://wildfloursateliergoods.wiki.gg/wiki/Wildflour%27s_Atelier_Goods_Wiki]WAG WIKI[/url]。[size=4]

[/size][size=4]我将物品按照wiki上的分类把它们放入不同的袋子。其中，因为Boutique和Confectioner这两个类别里的东西太[/size]多，一个袋子装不下，我把它们拆分了。

[size=4]工匠机器包由罗宾出售，剩下的能在皮埃尔和格斯的店里找到。
[/size]
[size=4]Based on the latest beta version of item bag, the original bag has been completely rewritten.

[/size][size=4]There are a total of 10 bags now, and 2 of them can be used in any situation. They are respectively the craftsman's machine bag and the field items bag. The remaining eight will only take effect when the advanced mode is enabled, so I have included them in the optional files. Please do not use them in the simple mode. For information on how to activate the advanced mode, please refer to the [/size][url=https://wildfloursateliergoods.wiki.gg/wiki/Wildflour%27s_Atelier_Goods_Wiki]WAG WIKI[/url][size=4].

[/size][size=4]I put the items into different bags according to the classification on the wiki. Among them, because there were too many items in the "Boutique" and "Confectioner" categories and one bag couldn't hold them all, I split them apart.

The craftsman machine bags are sold by Robin, and the rest can be found in Pierre and Gus' store.

[/size][size=6][b][i]
有兴趣可以加一下我的汉化群，虽然现在没几个人，群号208011620，到时候如果有什么mod需要汉化或者说有什么mod有item bag的需求可以和我说[/i][/b][/size]
